+"""CLI for the isolated Docker browser-handoff acceptance gate."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from src.logging import get_logger
+from test_support.browser_handoff.constants import (
+    DEFAULT_IMAGE,
+    DEFAULT_OUTPUT,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+)
+from test_support.browser_handoff.docker_gate import GateConfig, GateError, run_gate
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        description="Run the Docker browser-handoff success and failure journeys."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--output",
+        type=Path,
+        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT,
+        help="New artifact directory; existing paths are rejected.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--image",
+        default=DEFAULT_IMAGE,
+        help="Container image used by all isolated services.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--timeout",
+        type=float,
+        default=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
+        help="Per-journey deadline in seconds.",
+    )
+    return parser
+
+
+def _parse_args(argv: list[str] | None) -> GateConfig:
+    parser = _parser()
+    arguments = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if arguments.timeout <= 0:
+        parser.error("--timeout must be greater than zero")
+    if not arguments.image.strip():
+        parser.error("--image must not be empty")
+    return GateConfig(
+        output=arguments.output.resolve(),
+        image=arguments.image,
+        timeout_seconds=arguments.timeout,
+    )
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Run the gate and return a shell-compatible status code."""
+    try:
+        output = run_gate(_parse_args(argv))
+    except GateError as error:
+        logger.error("browser handoff gate failed", reason=str(error))
+        sys.stderr.write(f"browser-handoff gate failed: {error}\n")
+        return 1
+    logger.info("browser handoff gate passed", output=str(output))
+    sys.stdout.write(f"browser-handoff artifacts: {output}\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
